Description.LocalizedString: A small fish with orange and blue colors. Its fins have a beautiful orange-red hue, and its body has blue wavy stripes. Petite in size with vibrant, eye-catching colors, it is a favorite among ornamental fish enthusiasts.

UseContext.SourceString: 通过钓鱼获得，出售后可以获得鱼鳞币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtained through fishing. Can be sold for Scale Coins.

Description.SourceString: 通身墨绿的小型鱼类。体型虽小但性情凶蛮，是海洋中贪婪的狩猎者，背上与前胸布满华丽的毒刺，因此请务必不要贸然触碰。
Description.LocalizedString: A small fish with dark green body. Despite its small size, it is a fierce and voracious predator. Its back and chest are covered with ornate venomous spines, so be sure not to touch it carelessly.

UseContext.SourceString: 通过钓鱼获得，出售后可以获得鱼鳞币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtained through fishing. Can be sold for Scale Coins.

Description.SourceString: 外形奇特的小型鱼类。皮肤近乎透明，鱼骨轮廓极为突出的鱼类，远看仿佛只有一副骨架在游动，因此又有「骷髅鱼」的别名。
Description.LocalizedString: A small fish with an unusual appearance. Its skin is nearly transparent, making the skeletal outline extremely prominent. From a distance, it looks like nothing but a skeleton swimming through the water, hence the nickname, "Skeleton Fish."

UseContext.SourceString: 通过钓鱼获得，出售后可以获得鱼鳞币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtained by fishing. Can be sold for Scale Coins.

Description.SourceString:
会变色的软体动物。
在海中，有时候椰子壳里不一定是甘甜的椰子水。
Description.LocalizedString:
A color-changing mollusk.
In the sea, a coconut shell may hold something far stranger than sweet coconut water.

UseContext.SourceString: 通过钓鱼获得，出售后可以获得鱼鳞币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtained by fishing. Can be sold for Scale Coins.

Description.SourceString:
形似毯子的大型鱼类。
长着「猫耳朵」的海中「蝙蝠」，因其巨大的身躯和花纹被称为「魔鬼鱼」，但群聚在海边时反而像一锅馄饨皮。
Description.LocalizedString:
A large, blanket-shaped fish.
A sea "bat" with "cat ears." Its enormous body and markings earned it the name "devil ray," but when a group gathers near the shore, they look more like a pot of wonton wrappers.

UseContext.SourceString: 通过钓鱼获得，出售后可以获得鱼鳞币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtained through fishing. Can be sold for Scale Coins.

Description.SourceString: 带有闪耀蓝色的小型鱼类。性情温和，但见到同类则会为争夺地盘撕咬拼杀，建议与其他文静的鱼类同养，是观赏鱼中的珍品之一。
Description.LocalizedString: This small fish with shimmering blue colors is considered a prized gem among ornamental fish. Although mild-tempered, it will fight with its own kind over territory. Experts recommend keeping this fish with those of calm disposition.

UseContext.SourceString: 通过钓鱼获得，出售后可以获得鱼鳞币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtained through fishing. Can be sold for Scale Coins.

Description.SourceString: 带有迷宫状斑纹的小型鱼类。体表具有红白黄三色相间的斑纹，极其稀有且捕捞难度大，是观赏鱼中的 「梦幻品种」。
Description.LocalizedString: A small fish with interweaving stripes of red, white, and yellow, like a maze. This fish is extremely rare and difficult to catch, thus considered a legendary prize among ornamental fish.

UseContext.SourceString: 通过钓鱼获得，出售后可以获得鱼鳞币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtained through fishing. Can be sold for Scale Coins.

Description.SourceString: 黑绿相间的小型鱼类。体型是同类中的「巨人」，性喜独居，行踪不定，因此极难在市场上见到，独特的配色为它更添一层神秘色彩。
Description.LocalizedString: A small, mysterious fish marked by distinctive black and green colors. Large for its genus, this species prefers to wander alone. Difficult to find, it is extremely rare on the market.

UseContext.SourceString: 通过钓鱼获得，出售后可以获得鱼鳞币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtained through fishing. Can be sold for Scale Coins.

Description.SourceString: 宝石蓝色的小型鱼类。周身鱼鳍呈现美丽的银色，身上带有白色波纹状斑纹，体型娇小，色彩引人注目，通常单独或成对行动，深受观赏鱼养殖爱好者的喜爱。
Description.LocalizedString: A small fish with a sapphire color. Its fins have a beautiful silver hue, and its body has white wavy stripes. Petite in size with vibrant, eye-catching colors, it is a favorite among ornamental fish enthusiasts.

UseContext.SourceString: 通过钓鱼获得，出售后可以获得鱼鳞币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtained through fishing. Can be sold for Scale Coins.

Description.SourceString: 带有灰红斑纹的小型鱼类。体型虽小但性情凶蛮，是海洋中贪婪的狩猎者，背上与前胸布满华丽的毒刺，因此请务必不要贸然触碰。
Description.LocalizedString: A small fish with gray-red stripes. Fierce and predatory despite its size, its back and chest are lined with ornate venomous spines—handle with extreme care.

UseContext.SourceString: 通过钓鱼获得，出售后可以获得鱼鳞币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtained through fishing. Can be sold for Scale Coins.

Description.SourceString: 身形细长的大型鱼类。银色的身体上带有红橙蓝相间的斑纹，较为罕见，常被误认为是龙的幼崽，因此对它也有「龙宫使者」的称号。
Description.LocalizedString: A large fish with a long, slender body. Its silver scales are traced with interwoven stripes of red, orange, and blue. Rarely seen, it is often mistaken for a young dragon, earning it the folk title of "Messenger of the Dragon Palace."

UseContext.SourceString: 通过钓鱼获得，出售后可以获得鱼鳞币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Obtained by fishing. Can be sold for Scale Coins.

Description.SourceString:
柔软漂亮的浮游生物。
水母没有心脏，它们从水里诞生，最终也和海水融为一体。
Description.LocalizedString:
A soft, beautiful planktonic creature.
Jellyfish have no hearts. Born of water, they return to the sea in the end.

UseContext.SourceString: 落雨庭钓点收获的特殊纪念品，售出时可获得鱼鳞币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A special memento obtained at the Raindrop Court Fishing Spot. Can be sold for Scale Coins.

Description.SourceString:
落雨庭作为绘莉小姐人偶剧《青色朝露》的取景地，许多粉丝都会佩戴以剧中青露花发饰为原型设计的胸针前来打卡。
「或许天又要下雨了……」
Description.LocalizedString:
As the filming location for Miss Ellie's puppet show "Blue Morning Dew," the Raindrop Court draws many fans who visit wearing brooches modeled after the iconic Blue Dew Flower hairpiece from the show.
"Maybe it's going to rain again…"

UseContext.SourceString: 水菱湖钓点收获的特殊纪念品，售出时可获得鱼鳞币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A special memento obtained at the Caltrop Lake Fishing Spot. Can be sold for Scale Coins.

Description.SourceString: 伪装成水菱湖水怪模样的纳库佩达摆件，据说还是限量款……难道丑的东西更保值吗？
Description.LocalizedString: A Nacupeda decor modeled after the Caltrop Lake monster. Supposedly it's limited edition… Does being ugly actually help it increase in value?

UseContext.SourceString: 鹦鹉螺隧道西钓点收获的特殊纪念品，售出时可获得鱼鳞币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A special memento obtained at the Nautili Tunnel West Fishing Spot. Can be sold for Scale Coins.

Description.SourceString: 「准备和呗友奔现了，一起打了半年多的泯除方块，没见过照片，但也互寄过礼物，准备给呗友一个惊喜！成功的话就改名叫『薯条真好吃』，失败就叫『不要番茄酱』，可以关注我的呗果号，主页有……」
Description.LocalizedString: "I'm finally meeting my Bagel buddy in person. We've been playing Tetrominoes together for over six months. I've never seen their photo, but we've swapped gifts, and I'm planning to surprise them! If it goes well I'll change my name to 'French Fries Are So Good'; if it flops it'll be 'No Ketchup'. You can follow my Bagel account—details on my profile…"

UseContext.SourceString: 湛望角钓点收获的特殊纪念品，售出时可获得鱼鳞币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A special memento from the Azure Vista Fishing Spot. Can be sold for Scale Coins.

Description.SourceString: 环海公路经常会出现迦楼罗和海鸥的斗争，目前胜率各半，海鸥失去了羽毛和薯条，迦楼罗失去了头发和围巾。
Description.LocalizedString: Along the Coastal Highway, clashes between Garuda and seagulls are quite common. So far they're evenly matched: the seagulls have lost feathers and french fries, and Garuda has lost hair and a scarf.

UseContext.SourceString: 理想馆钓点收获的特殊纪念品，售出时可获得鱼鳞币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A special memento obtained from the Imaginist Fishing Spot. Can be sold for Scale Coins.

Description.SourceString: 当红乐团「Invictus」主唱西汀的亲签手幅，其粉丝群体拥有相当强大的购买力。
Description.LocalizedString: A personally signed banner from Settyn, the lead vocalist of the hit band "Invictus." Their fanbase has ridiculously deep pockets.

UseContext.SourceString: 星渚游艇码头钓点收获的特殊纪念品，售出时可获得鱼鳞币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A special memento obtained at the Stellar Marina Fishing Spot. Can be sold for Scale Coins.

Description.SourceString: 一张只写有联系方式的黑金色名片，在寸土寸金的新赫兰德区，就算是钓鱼也会钓上机遇。
Description.LocalizedString: A black-and-gold namecard with nothing on it but contact info. In the New Herland District — where every inch of land is worth its weight in gold — you can reel in opportunities even while fishing.

UseContext.SourceString: 鹦鹉螺隧道东钓点收获的特殊纪念品，售出时可获得鱼鳞币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A special memento obtained from the Nautili Tunnel East Fishing Spot. Can be sold for Scale Coins.

Description.SourceString: 「……咔叽玛薯条日，v我500方斯，聆听我的告白后续。」
Description.LocalizedString: "…On Clicky Fries Day, send me 500 Fons and I'll continue my confession."

UseContext.SourceString: 海角广场钓点收获的特殊纪念品，售出时可获得鱼鳞币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A special memento obtained at the Cape Square Fishing Spot. Can be sold for Scale Coins.

Description.SourceString: 「特工Z世代」5周年线下演出特别纪念款应援棒，虽然电池已经没了，但梦想依旧闪闪发光。
Description.LocalizedString: A special 5th-anniversary commemorative support light stick from "Gen Z" — although the battery's dead, the dream still shines bright.

UseContext.SourceString: 向阳岛钓点收获的特殊纪念品，售出时可获得鱼鳞币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A special memento obtained at the Sunward Island Fishing Spot. Can be sold for Scale Coins.

Description.SourceString: 模糊不清的异象市民证，它曾经属于一位被爱着的幸运异象。
Description.LocalizedString: A blurred, waterlogged Anomaly Citizen ID. It once belonged to a fortunate Anomaly who was deeply loved.

UseContext.SourceString: 无用的钓鱼收获，并不值几个鱼鳞币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Useless fishing haul—barely worth a few Scale Coins.

Description.SourceString: 已经被水腐蚀的老旧电池，捞起来的唯一作用是阻止它进一步污染环境，海特洛市政部门会感谢你对海特洛水质保护做出的贡献。
Description.LocalizedString: This old battery has been corroded by water. Pulling it out prevents it from polluting the environment any further, and Hethereau Municipality will appreciate your contribution to protecting Hethereau's water quality.

UseContext.SourceString: 无用的钓鱼收获，并不值几个鱼鳞币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Useless fishing haul—barely worth a few Scale Coins.

Description.SourceString: 连罐头商人都不会回收的劣质锡料，可以换到一句：「哦我的叉叉派！这东西看起来像柯恩的鼻涕！哦，柯恩是我们工厂的看门歧骸。」
Description.LocalizedString: Low-grade tin, so crappy even can merchants won't take it. You can trade it for one line: "Oh my X_X! This stuff looks like Koen's snot! Oh, Koen's the Oddity who watches over our factory."

UseContext.SourceString: 珍贵的钓鱼纪念品，阅读后可获得大量垂钓经验。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A rare fishing memento. Grants a large amount of Fishing EXP.

Description.SourceString:
作者：「海上一钓客」
扉页：送给每一位钓者，送给每一段或遗憾或美好的钓鱼时光。
Description.LocalizedString:
Author: "A Sea Angler"
Dedication: To every angler, and to every fishing moment—whether tinged with regret or beauty.

UseContext.SourceString: 珍贵的钓鱼纪念品，售出时可以获得大量鱼鳞币。
UseContext.LocalizedString: A valuable fishing memento. Can be sold for a large number of Scale Coins.

Description.SourceString: 发售时以「能增加钓鱼幸运值」作为噱头，但实际证明并没有什么太大用处，好在是金的。
Description.LocalizedString: Marketed at launch with the gimmick of "boosting your Fishing Luck", but it turned out to be pretty much useless. At the very least, it's made of solid gold.
